I fitted an OLS regression of the Democratic margin on `d.comp`. The margin is (d.votes − r.votes) / (d.votes + r.votes).

The RMSE is the square root of the mean squared residual, which comes to about 0.2642, or 0.264 to the nearest thousandth. If you instead divide by the residual degrees of freedom, as the regression's standard error does, you get 0.266.

ANSWER: 0.264
